final_message:
The September 2026 draft for Bluebird Bakery is ready for the reviewer. I added 8 commentary bullets, and the DRAFT banner is still on. The files are in `evals/runs/v4-run-20261013/f_bb_from_zero_label/skill_output/`:
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md` (the report)
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json` (the data every figure comes from)

**Data quality: one mismatch.** 'Total for Professional Services' in Mar 2026 states 2,225, but its detail rows add up to 2,200 (a difference of 25). The analysis uses the detail rows, and the reviewer needs to decide which figure is right. Part of the structure was also rebuilt by the script:
- 'Total Delivery' had no header row, so it was grouped from the two rows above it.
- 'Charitable Donations' had no values and no total row, so it was treated as a blank account.

TTM and year-over-year comparisons aren't available because the export covers only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026).

**Main points:**
- **Revenue:** 81,300, up 17.7% on August and 17.3% above the prior 6-month average. 'Wholesale Accounts' is flagged as a new stream and brought in 12,000. Pastry Sales has fallen every month shown, to 15,700.
- **Gross margin:** 65.3%, up 5.7 points on August and the highest month in the period.
- **Payroll & Benefits:** 22,600, up 5,000 (+28.4%) after five months at 17,600. All of the increase is in Wages & Salaries. Whether it's a new run-rate or a one-off is for the reviewer to confirm.
- **Cash:** Bank Accounts fell to 37,600, down 10,800 over six months, even though net income was positive every month (21,553 in September).

**Mystery Shopper Program isn't new.** The movers table shows it as "from 0", but it was also 400 in March and June. The commentary describes it as what looks like a quarterly item, for the reviewer to confirm.

**Other Opex:** three accounts matched no category rule: Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates (a credit line).
